svg.title: SparkRing on two or four DGX Sparks
svg.desc: Node A, the DGX Spark on your network, runs sparkring install and serves the OpenAI-compatible API and the status dashboard. The installer sets up every Spark, distributes the image once, places the pinned checkpoint and starts one serving container per Spark, each a tensor-parallel rank. Sparks are joined only by direct 200 Gb/s ConnectX-7 cables: a pair by one cable from p0 to p0, a four-Spark ring by four cables from each Spark's p0 to the next Spark's p1. Traffic between opposite Sparks of a ring crosses two cables, and the ConnectX-7 of the Spark between them forwards it in hardware.
